steps.instruction: Baseline: before the series, explicitly assign the existing AB macro, Play Once, 20 ms, to the on-screen Button 4 control. During this capture do nothing. Do not click Save to mouse or press the physical Button 4. Leave Button 5 unchanged.

AB must already be assigned to Button 4 from the baseline. Prepare its editor before ENTER. After Capturing starts: change only Play Once to Toggle Repeat and click Done. Do not manually reassign, edit any event or timing, save onboard, or execute the macro.

Keep AB assigned to Button 4. Prepare the same AB editor before ENTER. After Capturing starts: change only Toggle Repeat to Hold Repeat and click Done. Do not manually reassign or change events, timing, name, Button 5 or any other setting.

Keep AB assigned to Button 4. Prepare the same AB editor before ENTER. After Capturing starts: change only Hold Repeat to Play Once and click Done. Do not manually reassign. AB must keep its original 20 ms timeline. Do not click Save to mouse.

Prepare the on-screen Button 4 assignment view before ENTER. After Capturing starts, change only Button 4 from AB to Mouse Function > Back. Leave the AB macro as Play Once and leave Button 5 unchanged. No Save to mouse and no physical macro execution.
